svg.title: Take the A Train — chord path in C
svg.desc: Equally measured fretboard grids for chorus and verse, frets eight through ten on D, A, and low E strings. Chorus C6 to D7 to Dm to G7 to C6, second pass C6 to Dm to G7 then verse. Verse F6 to D7 to Dm to G7. D7 and Dm are separate graph nodes within low E fret ten. Solid arrows mark first pass, dotted arrows second pass.

rect.style: transform:translate(160.5px, 713px);transition:transform 180ms ease-out, width 180ms ease-out, height 180ms ease-out
